title: Dizzy, Burning, and Fighting for the Win

text_block_list.name: Newscaster
text_block_list.text: Mihono Bourbon, who ran in this year's Classics, is now taking an extended break due to an injury.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: What?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: This shocking news breaks right after the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I brought apples and bananas! I'll just put them here for you!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I hope you get better soon so we can run together in our senior year!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: …I apologize. I don't know whether or not I'll be able to run again.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: The doctor just told me that my injury will take a long time to heal. That could mean… I might—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I-I'm sure you'll get better! Don't worry!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Your attitude is really important in healing, so make sure you stay optimistic! Okay?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: …Understood. Thank you for your kind words.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: …By the way. Is Rice doing well?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: R-Rice?! She's… um…

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: She's doing fantastic! Obviously!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Oh, man… I really did it this time. I lied right to her face when put on the spot.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: …I wish Rice could have come with me to visit Bourbon.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Um, the thing is… Today might not be a good day for Rice to go. She's been feeling very down.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: …She said she feels like it's her fault Bourbon was injured.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Whaaat?! There's no way that's true!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: I agree with you… I also suspect that's not the only reason she's feeling down.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Um… You know how she was trying to catch up to Bourbon during the Classics this year?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Her goal suddenly disappeared, and I think she's at a loss for what to do now.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Bourbon seemed worried too. I wish there was some way I could help.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Hm… What to dooo…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bzzz! ♪

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Oh, it's Nature. I wonder what she wants.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Hey, Nature!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Yaaahhh!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Woo, Nature! Lookin' good!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Tannhauser! Sorry for calling you over here while you were out and about!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: No worries! I was planning on doing some training anyway. But what made you want to run with me all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Um… Well, the thing is…

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: You've cheered me up so many times since I've known you.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I… have?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Yeah, you have. Like when I was feeling down after that scrimmage with Teio and McQueen…

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Though… I could probably stand to learn a thing or two from you.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: And when I was depressed after the news was talking about the Kikuka Sho not having its biggest star…

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: You just have to win so convincingly that no one will even compare you to Teio.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: …Huh?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I think that's your only option! You gotta win by a landslide! So that everyone forgets about Teio completely!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: You really helped me out back then—you gave me the strength I needed to do my best.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: …And now Tokai Teio and I are both going to run in the next Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I wanna give it all I've got and prove that I have what it takes too.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: So before the Arima Kinen… I wanna run against one of the Umamusume I respect the most!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Nice Nature gives Matikanetannhauser a hard slap on the back.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Aye yi?!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I'm only gonna say this once! You've saved me time and time again!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: You're the one in my heart cheering me on and telling me not to give up.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: It's because you've always given me the push I needed that I've gotten as far as I have.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: You mean… I inspired you?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Yeah, you really did.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: It's because you're you that they're so inspired!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: I want you to believe in that power more than anyone!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: …Huh. How about that? I really inspired you.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: You know…

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: That kinda makes me feel all warm and fuzzy. Haha, I think I get it now.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: …What do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Nothing! Now come on, Nature! Let's go!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Huh? What's going on?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: We're racing, aren't we? I'm not gonna lose!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, the two begin racing with the setting sun behind them.

text_block_list.name: Tannhauser & Nature
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: They pass each other multiple times as they run, and each time it happens, both of them pick up the pace.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Even from afar, I can tell they're going all out. It's hard to believe this started as a playful match.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I suddenly notice another Umamusume watching their race intently.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I won't lose! I won't lose! I won't lose! I CAN WIN!

text_block_list.name: Tannhauser & Nature
text_block_list.text: YAAAHHH!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The two dive for the finish line, tumble on the turf, and get lost in the colors of the sunset.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It seems Director Akikawa's hope for her has taken root and is slowly starting to sprout.
